parameters.name: OrderId
parameters.description:
The order ID. You can find the order ID on the <props="china">[Orders](https://usercenter2.aliyun.com/order/list?pageIndex=1\&pageSize=20) page in the Billing Management console.</props>
<props="intl">[Orders](https://usercenter2-intl.aliyun.com/order/list?pageIndex=1\&pageSize=20\&spm=5176.12818093.top-nav.ditem-ord.36f016d0OQFmJa) page in the Billing Management console.</props>
><notice>You cannot use an order ID to query Serverless instances.></notice>

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the instance is located.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. You can view the resource group ID in the Resource Group console.

parameters.name: Series
parameters.description:
The instance series. You can use this parameter to filter instances. Valid values:

- v2

- v3

- confluent

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key.

- If you do not specify this parameter, all tag keys are matched.

- The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value.

- If you do not specify the `Key` parameter, you do not need to specify this parameter. If you leave this parameter empty, all tag values are matched.

- The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
